name: OpenLiteSpeed
comment: Official LiteSpeed binary release. OpenLiteSpeed lives in /usr/local/lsws by design: each version is kept here unpacked and activate.sh runs that version's own upstream installer in upgrade mode. A server installed from the LiteSpeed repository is switched over too: the engine copies the configuration (keep_on_switch) before the package is removed and puts it back exactly afterwards; activate.sh also keeps conf/ and admin/conf/ as they were around every installer run.
